 Latest news The Social Security Administration will send an early payment on November 10. Here’s why the payment is being issued ahead of schedule.
 Getty Images Social Security U.S. Social Security: Why is this week’s November payment being issued early?
 Corina González twitter Greg Heilman Update: Nov 10th, 2026 06:07 EST Share Make us preferred on Google On November 10, the Social Security Administration (SSA) will issue another round of early payments .
 According to the agency’s payment schedule, the payment was originally scheduled to be sent on Wednesday, November 11. However, because this date coincides with one of the 11 federal holidays observed in the United States, the payment will be issued ahead of schedule. 
 Why does Social Security issue payments early when a holiday falls on a scheduled payment date? 
 On Tuesday, November 10 , the Social Security Administration (SSA) will issue payments to beneficiaries whose birthdays fall between the 1st and the 10th of any month. 
 These payments were originally scheduled for the second Wednesday of the month, November 11. However, Veterans Day , one of the 11 federal holidays recognized by the U.S. government, falls on that date.
 According to the Social Security Administration’s payment schedule, if a payment date falls on a federal holiday or weekend, the payment is moved to the preceding business day . In this case, payments will be issued on Tuesday, November 10.
 Here’s when all Social Security payments will be issued in November 2026 
 According to the SSA’s official payment schedule, Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments are issued on the first day of each month . Payments for beneficiaries who began receiving benefits before May 1997 are issued on the third day of each month .
 For people who receive both SSI and Social Security benefits, SSI payments are issued on the first day of the month, while Social Security payments arrive on the third day. 
 The remaining Social Security payments, including retirement, family, spousal, divorced-spouse, survivor, and Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) benefits, are issued on the second, third, or fourth Wednesday of each month , depending on beneficiaries’ birth dates:
 Second Wednesday of the month: Beneficiaries born between the 1st and the 10th. 
 Third Wednesday of the month: Beneficiaries born between the 11th and the 20th. 
 Fourth Wednesday of the month: Beneficiaries born between the 21st and the 31st. 
 If any scheduled payment date falls on a federal holiday or weekend, the payment is issued on the preceding business day. 
 November 2026 Social Security payment schedule 
 The following Social Security payments have already been issued this month:
 Friday, October 30: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits for November. 
 Tuesday, November 3: Payments for beneficiaries who began receiving benefits before May 1997. 
 According to the official schedule, the remaining November 2026 Social Security payments will be issued on the following dates:
 Tuesday, November 10: Payments for beneficiaries born between the 1st and the 10th. 
 Wednesday, November 18: Payments for beneficiaries born between the 11th and the 20th. 
 Wednesday, November 25: Payments for beneficiaries born between the 21st and the 31st. 
 The agency currently distributes monthly payments through direct deposit and the Direct Express debit card . Previously, beneficiaries could also receive their payments by mail in the form of paper checks. However, this payment method was discontinued in September of last year.
 Anyone who previously received Social Security benefits by mail must update their payment method to continue receiving their monthly benefits.
